description: Send up to three explicit options to the phone and return a durable pending requestId. IMPORTANT: call nofax_wait_for_response and repeat while pending; do not choose on the human's behalf.

message.description: Question or decision context shown to the human.

options.description: One to three explicit choices to present to the human.

anyOf.description: String shorthand for a choice value; its first 32 characters are also used as the human-facing label.

label.description: Short human-facing label displayed for this choice.

value.description: Choice value returned as the terminal human decision.

title.description: Optional choice prompt title shown to the human; defaults to "Nofax choice".

name: nofax_request_choice

instruction.description: Fail-closed next-step instruction for the caller.

mustWait.description: Signals that the caller must keep waiting for a terminal human response.

status.description: The request is unresolved and must not be treated as approval.

title: Request human choice
